messages.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

### Short answer
For an Aerospace / Defense radar use case, the passages do not directly place a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester inside a radar-specific workflow; they support placing it in the communications-device test lane—signaling/protocol/application with R&S CMX500 / CMW500, and non-signaling RF / production with instruments such as CMP180—while radar-specific testing is covered separately by radar echo generation or RF/spectrum analysis tools.[55][67][7]
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Where Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Radar stimulus / radar echo simulation | Knowledge base supports R&S AREG800A as an automotive radar echo generator with dynamic artificial object generation, not as a signaling/non-signaling communications tester.[22][67] | [22][67] |
| RF / parametric / characterization | The 5G device testing value-chain mapping places RF / parametric / characterization with R&S SMW200A, R&S FSW and oscilloscopes, not with signaling testers.[55] | [55] |
| Signaling / protocol / application | The same mapping places signaling / protocol / application with R&S CMX500, R&S CMW500 and R&S CMsquares.[55] | [55] |
| Non-signaling RF / production | The value-chain list includes Non-signaling RF as a test type, and maps production / manufacturing tools to R&S CMP180, CMP200, CMW100 and CMX500 / CMW500.[13][55] | [13][55] |
| Wireless communication modules on UAV / defense platforms | For UAV communications, CMX500 is described as testing LTE, 5G and Wi‑Fi UE signaling, with RF measurements such as power, frequency, spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER and MIMO, plus application-layer and protocol tests.[36] | [36] |
| Multi-radio interference / desense around communications links | CMX500 can perform WLAN + cellular interference / desense testing with real connections and parallel LTE + NR + Wi‑Fi measurements.[37][85] | [37][85] |
### Practical placement
【推論】In a radar-related Aerospace / Defense workflow, use radar-specific tools for radar echo / RF characterization, and place the Signaling Tester when the DUT also has LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communications that need signaling, protocol, application, OTA or desense validation.[55][36][37][67]
【推論】Place the Non-signaling Tester later or in parallel for RF parametric / manufacturing-style checks, because the value-chain mapping separates non-signaling RF and production / manufacturing from signaling / protocol / application testing.[13][55]
【推論】Do not position a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the primary radar target simulator unless another source directly states that link, because the radar echo-generation role is supported for AREG800A while CMX500/CMP180 passages support communications testing roles.[67][1][7]

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › 未決事項
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] 中 RF generator / analyzer frequency range 表格 OCR 呈現方式不清，表格同時出現 **400 MHz to 8000 MHz** 與 **requires R&S CMP-K168** for **6000 MHz to 8000 MHz**；本頁採 ordering information 的 **Extended frequency range, from 6 GHz to 8 GHz** 作為配置說明，不自行推導各 RF unit SKU 的所有頻段行為。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] 列出 **R&S CMP-PB18B**、**R&S CMP-PB18H**、**R&S CMP-B41H** 作為 trigger / multi-instrument interface 條件，但 ordering information 中列出 **R&S CMP-PB18I**、**R&S CMP-B40J**、**R&S CMP-B41J**；來源未說明 B/H/I/J variant 對應關係。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] 未展開 SnapN connector 的機械規格。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] 未提供 [[R&S CMPflexx system]] 的完整架構，只在 extras 中列出 multi-instrument connection cable set。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] 未提供 [[R&S NRPx power sensors]] 支援型號清單。

- High yield of devices with high quality。
- Achieve shortest test time possible；time = money。
- Characterize and optimize parametric RF transceiver sub systems。
- Debug and trace。

來源列出的 manufacturing / production 相關工具包含 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100]]、[[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMW500]] for signaling 與 [[R&S CMQ]]。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

- 5G NR UE 上市前需要通過符合 [[3GPP]] specifications 的 device certification。
- [[RF pre-conformance testing]] 又稱 design verification。
- RF pre-conformance testing 應在產品開發早期開始，用於及早找出並處理問題，減少延遲並提升最終產品品質。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 3GPP RF pre-conformance WebGUI solution 提供執行 **NR-FR1 Standalone（SA）** test cases 的平台，依據 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] specification。
- Manual verification capabilities 適合 early-stage validation、debugging 與 step-by-step verification。
- Test case procedures 針對 R&D use cases 最佳化，使用 specification 中最相關的 configurations。

- [[R&S CMX-KC661B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- [[R&S CMsequencer]] automated execution / validation / reporting。
- [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] selected test cases。

RF pre-conformance testing
[[RF pre-conformance testing]] 是在正式 device certification / conformance testing 前，於研發早期對 RF 行為進行的 design verification；在 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 中，它指 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 執行 selected 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test cases 的 WebGUI workflow。

5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing › WebGUI workflow 摘要
典型流程包含：

1. 補償 signal path attenuation。
2. 在 Frequency Dependent Attenuation tab 定義 attenuation tables。
3. 在 RF Connections tab 將 attenuation tables / fixed values 連結到特定 [[RF path]]。
4. 開啟 3GPP Pre-conformance testing workspace。
5. 在 configuration sidebar 設定 band 與 frequency settings。
6. 啟動 network emulation 並使 cell Go Live。
7. 確認 [[DUT]] 已連接。
8. 選擇 test case 與 Test ID。
9. Test ID 依 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] tables 設定 RB allocation 與 modulation scheme。
10. 點擊 Apply 執行 test case。

[[CMX500_Callbox]] 以簡報方式補充此 workflow 的 sales wording：3GPP Pre-Conformance Wizard takes care of 3GPP RMC settings，並可在 GUI 中 quick and easy 進行 3GPP pre-conformance testing。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

R&S AREG800A › R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D
RF transfer characteristics 量測條件：with diplexer between RX and TX，frequency step size `2.5 MHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 kHz`，window function normal gate（Hann），type bandpass filter，measured from RX waveguide input to waveguide TX output connector。

- Amplitude flatness：[[R&S AREG8-B9]] `< ±1 dB in 1 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±2 dB in 2 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±5 dB in 4 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`。
- Group delay flatness：[[R&S AREG8-B9]] `< ±0.5 ns in 1 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±1 ns in 2 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±1 ns in 4 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`。

R&S AREG800A › R&S AREG8-24S / R&S AREG8-24D
- RF frequency range：`24.0 GHz to 24.25 GHz`。
- RF instantaneous bandwidth：`250 MHz`。
- IF center frequency：`825 MHz for 250 MHz bandwidth`。
- Maximum number supported：`4`；one IF path per [[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] option required。
- Absolute maximum RX power at frontend：`0 dBm (nom.)`。
- Maximum TX power at frontend：`≥ 15 dBm (meas.)`。
- RF transfer characteristics measurement conditions：with diplexer between RX and TX，frequency step size `2.5 MHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 kHz`，window function normal gate（Hann），type bandpass filter。
- Amplitude flatness：[[R&S AREG8-B9]]，`< ±2 dB in 250 MHz bandwidth (meas.)`。

### Short answer
For an Aerospace / Defense radar use case, the passages do not directly place a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester inside a radar-specific workflow; they support placing it in the communications-device test lane—signaling/protocol/application with R&S CMX500 / CMW500, and non-signaling RF / production with instruments such as CMP180—while radar-specific testing is covered separately by radar echo generation or RF/spectrum analysis tools.[55][67][7]
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Where Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Radar stimulus / radar echo simulation | Knowledge base supports R&S AREG800A as an automotive radar echo generator with dynamic artificial object generation, not as a signaling/non-signaling communications tester.[22][67] | [22][67] |
| RF / parametric / characterization | The 5G device testing value-chain mapping places RF / parametric / characterization with R&S SMW200A, R&S FSW and oscilloscopes, not with signaling testers.[55] | [55] |
| Signaling / protocol / application | The same mapping places signaling / protocol / application with R&S CMX500, R&S CMW500 and R&S CMsquares.[55] | [55] |
| Non-signaling RF / production | The value-chain list includes Non-signaling RF as a test type, and maps production / manufacturing tools to R&S CMP180, CMP200, CMW100 and CMX500 / CMW500.[13][55] | [13][55] |
| Wireless communication modules on UAV / defense platforms | For UAV communications, CMX500 is described as testing LTE, 5G and Wi‑Fi UE signaling, with RF measurements such as power, frequency, spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER and MIMO, plus application-layer and protocol tests.[36] | [36] |
| Multi-radio interference / desense around communications links | CMX500 can perform WLAN + cellular interference / desense testing with real connections and parallel LTE + NR + Wi‑Fi measurements.[37][85] | [37][85] |
### Practical placement
【推論】In a radar-related Aerospace / Defense workflow, use radar-specific tools for radar echo / RF characterization, and place the Signaling Tester when the DUT also has LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communications that need signaling, protocol, application, OTA or desense validation.[55][36][37][67]
【推論】Place the Non-signaling Tester later or in parallel for RF parametric / manufacturing-style checks, because the value-chain mapping separates non-signaling RF and production / manufacturing from signaling / protocol / application testing.[13][55]
【推論】Do not position a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the primary radar target simulator unless another source directly states that link, because the radar echo-generation role is supported for AREG800A while CMX500/CMP180 passages support communications testing roles.[67][1][7]

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

- LTE + NR + WiFi Measurements in parallel。
